verdict.rationale: Founder Law is a founder-focused immigration and corporate law firm that sells attorney-managed, flat-fee legal packages and explicitly positions itself as attorney-led rather than an automated tool. A downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec is outside this kind of professional legal service. Nothing in the evidence shows it offers any programmatic API, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI path returning 404, so this capability axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
